resolution.note: Chat voice picker + engagement hook complete across 7 children (8 originally; ticket 8 rewound in 7c72185). The pre-merge smoke step in IMPL §7 (open chat UI as pro, run a handful of adversarial queries in each voice) is the operator's last check before merge of PR #69.
